$comment: Production dependencies allowed despite a licence outside the allowlist in scripts/licenses.ts. Keys are package names; a trailing * matches a prefix. Each entry needs a reason; keep this list short.

@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk.reason: Anthropic terms; tolerated as in T3 Code; recheck before public release.

@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-*.reason: Per-platform builds of @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk (its bundled Claude Code binary), under the same Anthropic terms; same exception, recheck with it.

khroma.reason: MIT per its bundled license file (khroma@2.1.0/license); its package.json omits the licence field. Pulled in by mermaid.

caniuse-lite.reason: CC-BY-4.0 browser-support data (attribution kept in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md), pulled in by next for apps/site; data, not code, and never shipped in the Desktop App or Daemon.

@img/sharp-libvips-*.reason: LGPL-3.0-or-later prebuilt libvips, loaded dynamically by sharp (an optional dependency of next) for apps/site's image optimisation; unmodified, never copied into Polaris and never shipped in the Desktop App or Daemon.

botid.reason: MIT per the publisher README bundled in botid@1.5.11 and https://www.npmjs.com/package/botid; this published package omits its licence field and LICENSE file. Required Vercel bot detection for apps/site only, never shipped in the Desktop App or Daemon.

@img/sharp-win32-arm64.reason: Apache-2.0 AND LGPL-3.0-or-later Windows sharp build with bundled libvips, an optional dependency of next for apps/site image optimisation; unmodified, never copied into Polaris and never shipped in the Desktop App or Daemon. Same accepted exception as @img/sharp-libvips-*.

@img/sharp-win32-ia32.reason: Apache-2.0 AND LGPL-3.0-or-later Windows sharp build with bundled libvips, an optional dependency of next for apps/site image optimisation; unmodified, never copied into Polaris and never shipped in the Desktop App or Daemon. Same accepted exception as @img/sharp-libvips-*.

@img/sharp-win32-x64.reason: Apache-2.0 AND LGPL-3.0-or-later Windows sharp build with bundled libvips, an optional dependency of next for apps/site image optimisation; unmodified, never copied into Polaris and never shipped in the Desktop App or Daemon. Same accepted exception as @img/sharp-libvips-*.

glob.reason: BlueOak-1.0.0, a permissive licence (OSI-approved, patent grant, no copyleft). Pulled in by react-email's file discovery (glob) for apps/site's download email only; never shipped in the Desktop App or Daemon.

minimatch.reason: BlueOak-1.0.0, a permissive licence (OSI-approved, patent grant, no copyleft). Pulled in by react-email's file discovery (glob) for apps/site's download email only; never shipped in the Desktop App or Daemon.

minipass.reason: BlueOak-1.0.0, a permissive licence (OSI-approved, patent grant, no copyleft). Pulled in by react-email's file discovery (glob) for apps/site's download email only; never shipped in the Desktop App or Daemon.

path-scurry.reason: BlueOak-1.0.0, a permissive licence (OSI-approved, patent grant, no copyleft). Pulled in by react-email's file discovery (glob) for apps/site's download email only; never shipped in the Desktop App or Daemon.

lru-cache.reason: BlueOak-1.0.0, a permissive licence (OSI-approved, patent grant, no copyleft). Pulled in by react-email's file discovery (glob) for apps/site's download email only; never shipped in the Desktop App or Daemon.

mdn-data.reason: CC0-1.0 (public-domain dedication) CSS data, pulled in by css-tree in react-email's style inliner for apps/site's download email only; never shipped in the Desktop App or Daemon.

sax.reason: Build-time only: BlueOak-1.0.0, a permissive licence. xml2js pulls it in for @expo/config-plugins, which edits apps/mobile's generated native project (Info.plist, entitlements) during expo prebuild / run:ios. It runs on the developer's machine and is never in the Mobile App's JavaScript bundle or binary.

argparse.reason: Build-time only: Python-2.0 (PSF), a permissive licence. js-yaml pulls it in for @expo/xcpretty, which formats xcodebuild output while apps/mobile builds. It runs on the developer's machine and is never in the Mobile App's JavaScript bundle or binary.

railroad-diagrams.reason: CC0-1.0 (a public-domain dedication), a dependency of nearley that only its nearley-railroad CLI loads; sql-formatter (the Desktop App's SQL tab Format) pulls nearley in, and the runtime never imports it.

node-datachannel.reason: MPL-2.0 (declared as the non-SPDX "MPL 2.0"; its LICENSE is the MPL 2.0 text). A dependency of expo-device-hub, the Simulator's hub, which the Daemon installs on demand (scripts/simulatorLicenses.ts); loaded only for WebRTC streaming, unmodified, never copied into Polaris.

@node-datachannel/*.reason: Per-platform prebuilt addons of node-datachannel, under its MPL 2.0 (declared as "MPL 2.0"); same exception as node-datachannel.
